title: Bridget Jones's Diary
author: Helen Fielding
summary: Thirty-something Bridget Jones keeps a diary of her year, logging calories, cigarettes, glasses of wine and a messy love life that pits her charming, unreliable boss against a stiff family friend.
readIf: you want a funny, self-deprecating comfort read that loosely follows Pride and Prejudice.
skipIf: you dislike a heroine obsessed with weight and men, as it reflects 1990s attitudes.

pairings.reason: The original story it riffs on, wittier and quieter.
Another laugh-out-loud chick-lit heroine making a mess of her life.
Another funny first-person heroine, with a bigger emotional undercurrent.
